label: Khom · อักษรขอม

materials.label: Mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา

lede: Khom · อักษรขอม accounts for 2 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Phayao (50% of the corpus for this script), ahead of Chiang Mai. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (50%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (50%). Dated witnesses run 1912–1912 CE (1 of 2 carry a date).

findings.title: The minority hands: scripts beyond Tham Lanna
findings.gloss: Almost the whole collection is written in Tham Lanna.
